title: Anarchy Server (Vanilla)
body:
This is a public vanilla anarchy server, which means that everything except for hacking/exploiting is allowed.

The server is mostly vanilla, with a few notable QOL mods:
1. HuskHomes: TPA,Homes,RTP
2. ClickMobs/ClickVillagers: Allowed players to pick up friendly/neutral mobs and villagers into their inventory.

The server is hosted in Singapore, and is online 24/7 with low ping and smooth gameplay.

Join the official discord server here: https://discord.gg/RTg5PVhGA
